episodes.title: The Pilot
episodes.summary: A murder on Moonhaven puts Earth's last hope in jeopardy. During what should be a routine cargo loop to the Moon, pilot Bella Sway finds herself the subject of detective Paul Sarno's investigation.

episodes.title: The Detective
episodes.summary: Bella wants to get back to Earth, but must wait for Paul and Arlo to untangle a knot.

episodes.title: The Envoy
episodes.summary: Indira tries to get The Bridge back on track while Bella helps Paul uncover a conspiracy.

episodes.title: Mada
episodes.summary: On the brink of The Bridge, Paul prepares for some difficult goodbyes.

episodes.title: Dreadfeel
episodes.summary: Paul and Bella trek through unknown territory in search of Maite. Meanwhile, Arlo takes a journey of his own.

episodes.title: The Seeker
episodes.summary: In the season finale, Truelune is tested like never before.
